combos.name: Launcher relay
combos.how: A teammate's launcher sends the target up; your jump within 20 ticks starts an air combo with +1 hit and x1.2 damage

combos.name: Clone feint
combos.how: Your clones run in; the enemy turns to them; your teammate's next hit from behind is a crit

combos.name: Bomb line
combos.how: A teammate strings wire, you tag it: the tripwire bursts along its length

combos.name: Pincer
combos.how: Two squadmates on opposite sides of a target: both get +20% damage and the target cannot guard both

combos.name: Distract and take
combos.how: One distracts (any hit), the other takes: a stagger window of 30 ticks on the target. Taught by the cord test

combos.name: Shadow and strike
combos.how: While a target is possessed, every squadmate's hit is a crit

combos.name: Fang and swarm
combos.how: Fang over Fang homes on a target marked by insects; insects slow anyone the fang knocks down

combos.name: The triad formation
combos.needs: a Nara, an Akimichi and a Yamanaka
combos.how: Possession, then Mind Body Disturbance, then a Human Boulder: a three-step squad finisher (cinematic)

combos.name: Barrier and fire
combos.how: Fire jutsu cast inside your own barrier fill it: x2 burning for everyone trapped

combos.name: Cover fire
combos.needs: a thrower and a close fighter
combos.how: Thrown weapons at a target your teammate is fighting interrupt its guard (poise x1.5)

combos.name: Squad finisher
combos.how: With full momentum on two squadmates: each does their style's finisher on the same target in turn (cinematic)
